title: html2lvgl sidecar overrides
description: A `<page>.lvgl.json` file next to a page: attribute changes and removals applied to the generated widget tree by widget `name`. Mirrors validateOverrides() in src/overrides.mjs, which stays the authority; tests/sidecar-schema.test.mjs checks the two agree.

nodes.description: Widget name (the generated `name` attribute) to its override.

attrs.description: Values replace or add attributes; null removes one. A key is letters, digits and underscores with an optional LVGL state suffix, as in `style_bg_color:pressed`; `name` cannot be overridden. A key that breaks these rules is not a validation error: applying the sidecar skips it and reports OVERRIDE_ATTR_INVALID.

remove.description: Delete the node and its subtree.
